jobs.description: Work on innovative technical installations around the world Are you a hands-on engineer who enjoys travelling and solving technical challenges? Wat levert deze baan jou op? Work on unique international projects with customers around the world. Enjoy a high level of independence while being supported by an experienced technical team. Develop your career within an innovative and growing engineering company that invests in its people. By transforming customer requirements into sustainable, tailor-made solutions, the company has experienced significant growth in recent years, both nationally and internationally. Quality, innovation, safety and commitment are the foundation of the company's success. To support its continued growth, the organisation is looking for motivated professionals who are eager to develop their skills and contribute to challenging technical projects both in the Netherlands and abroad.
